sun.security.krb5.internal

类 LoginOptions

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.security.krb5.internal.util.KerberosFlags
      • sun.security.krb5.internal.KDCOptions
        • sun.security.krb5.internal.LoginOptions

  • public class LoginOptions
extends KDCOptions
    Implements the ASN.1 KDCOptions type. 
    
 KDCOptions   ::= KerberosFlags
      -- reserved(0),
      -- forwardable(1),
      -- forwarded(2),
      -- proxiable(3),
      -- proxy(4),
      -- allow-postdate(5),
      -- postdated(6),
      -- unused7(7),
      -- renewable(8),
      -- unused9(9),
      -- unused10(10),
      -- opt-hardware-auth(11),
      -- unused12(12),
      -- unused13(13),
 -- 15 is reserved for canonicalize
      -- unused15(15),
 -- 26 was unused in 1510
      -- disable-transited-check(26),
      -- renewable-ok(27),
      -- enc-tkt-in-skey(28),
      -- renew(30),
      -- validate(31)

 KerberosFlags ::= BIT STRING (SIZE (32..MAX))
                   -- minimum number of bits shall be sent,
                   -- but no fewer than 32

    This definition reflects the Network Working Group RFC 4120 specification available at http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc4120.txt.
